verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is a documentation page titled 'Scheduled Chats', which suggests time-based automatic runs of chats or agents. Nothing in the pack shows user-defined rules reacting to events such as webhooks, file uploads or incoming messages. Missing for 10: event-based trigger rules, condition/action rule definitions, webhook or event sources, and any detail or hands-on corroboration of how Scheduled Chats works.
